messages:
nina: FYI the pen-test report flagged a service-account misbind (possible RBAC lateral) and missing KMS audit slices on one ring. We need a 60m remediation + sealed evidence upload before retest. Who owns RBAC and who will package KMS evidence?

sam: I can own RBAC. Plan: snapshot current IAM, create a narrow custom role, attach to svc-canary, monitor 20m, then roll. Will prepare terraform plan and a rollback state.

lee: I'll take KMS audit exports. Will pull GCP Cloud Audit slices and AWS CloudTrail entries for CMEK. Will not rotate or rewrap keys until after capture.

hana: I'll create the evidence bucket with versioning + retention and generate sha256 + detached GPG signatures for each artifact. Will include capture commands in README.

oncall: Standby for the window. If control-plane breaks, page SRE. Rollback: reapply pre-iam JSON or terraform rollback-state.

nina: Proposed window: Wed 2024-09-25 17:00 UTC (60m). Sequence: pre-snapshots -> RBAC canary -> monitor -> export KMS logs -> seal/upload -> provide presigned links to vendor.

sam: Snapshot command example: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json`. Terraform snippet will be in PR. Rollback will use `gcloud projects set-iam-policy` with the snapshot.

lee: Example exports: GCP: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=30d --format=json > kms-gcp-30d.ndjson` AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-26 --end-time 2024-09-25 --query Events > kms-aws-30d.json`. Will also `describe-key` for metadata.

hana: Evidence manifest fields: filename, sha256, capture-command, operator, timestamp, signature-fingerprint. Example entry will be in README_FOR_VENDOR.md. I'll enable object lock and post presigned GETs.

nina: Compliance note: do not perform any key rotations or rewraps during evidence capture. Lee confirm no key ops.

lee: Confirmed. No destructive key ops until after artifacts are sealed.

oncall: I'll wire a short-lived alert for surge in `PERMISSION_DENIED` and SetIamPolicy events. If errors exceed threshold for 10m, we rollback.

sam: PR ETA: today EOD with tf plan + rollback instructions.

hana: I'll upload and post manifest + presigned links here after capture. Will sign each artifact with 0xA1B2C3D4.

vendor-bot: Vendor: please provide your PGP fingerprint to receive signed evidence. Retest requested after upload; slot preferred next day.

nina: OK all, react with :thumbsup: if you accept owners and window. I'll lock calendar and invite vendor once confirmed.

sam: :thumbsup:

lee: :thumbsup:

hana: :thumbsup:

oncall: :thumbsup:
